What bad looks like (anti-patterns we will not ship).md
`cache-components-suspense-dedupe` — 'use cache' with multiple Suspense boundaries on the same data.md
`edge-heavy-import` — Heavy  node-only import inside edge-runtime file.md
`headers-in-page` — Dynamic API call forcing dynamic rendering.md
`middleware-broad-matcher` — Middleware matcher missing or too broad.md
`missing-cache-headers` — Cacheable route or fetch with no caching (Cache-Control absent or no-store).md
`sveltekit-prerender-missing` — SvelteKit page without explicit prerender  ISR config.md
`turbo-force-bypass` — Turborepo cache bypass on a monorepo.md
`unoptimized-image` — Image optimization gap (raw img, global flag, missing sizes, or SVG mis-routed).md
`use-cache-date-stamp` — new Date()  Date.now()  Math.random() inside a 'use cache' file.md
